description: This file defines the ResourceModified event class, which is part of the policy event system in the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an event emitted after a Resource within a Policy has been modified, including methods for constructing instances, serializing/deserializing from JSON, and accessing properties related to the event.

classes.name: ResourceModified
classes.description: Final class representing a policy-related event indicating that a resource has been modified. It provides methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessing event-specific properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ResourceModified event instance using PolicyId, Label, Resource, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a ResourceModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, extracting event details from JSON format.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with the resource modification.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the Resource object that was modified.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the event's payload data to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to provide hash code based on label and resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ResourceModified instances based on label, resource, and super properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the ResourceModified instance.
